model_decisions.position_and_rotation: Store polygon placed at its source-derived Purdue local coordinates with identity transforms. Its long axis follows the east-west OSM edges; front faces south toward the separate canopy visible in imagery.
model_decisions.store_shell: The building body follows OSM way 345144282. Indiana 2018 footprint is a cross-check and has a larger, jogged outline whose relation to overhangs/appurtenances is uncertain.
model_decisions.floors_and_height: One level is source-tagged by OSM. Wall eave height 3.55 m and roof ridge 4.75 m are estimates from the oblique facade photo, not measurements.
model_decisions.roof: Low hipped dark shingle roof interpreted from site orthophoto and oblique storefront photo; exact pitch and eave line are unmeasured.
model_decisions.facade: South storefront uses the observed continuous red fascia, white trim, dark glazing, entrance, and square red sign. The Circle K logo text is simplified for massing.
model_decisions.fuel_canopy: Separate Mobil canopy placed south of the store from the site imagery. Footprint 22.6 by 7.6 m and height 5.15 m are estimates. Three islands and six dispenser blocks are modeled as appurtenances, consistent with visible site imagery and a location review; not included in the store footprint comparison.
model_decisions.asset_scope: The asset includes the store plus its attached station-service appurtenance canopy. No ground/site plane or unrelated structures are in the exported collection.
edits: Replaced the original single 8-vertex cuboid with an OSM-footprint shell.
Added a low hipped roof, south-facing storefront bays and door, fascia, and simplified brand signage using the location photos.
Added a separately named Mobil fuel canopy, supports, three pump islands, and six dispenser masses using imagery and the exact-site gallery.
unresolved: No measured elevations, construction drawings, or current image acquisition dates were available.
Indiana LiDAR footprint boundary extends beyond the OSM shell; the exact relationship of its jogged portion is unresolved.
Canopy footprint and height are approximate.
